description: Sync conversations, and every message, reply and internal note in them, from the Help Scout mailboxes you choose. Help Scout permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync conversations from the Help Scout mailboxes you select. Each conversation is one document with its preview, customer, assignee, mailbox and tags. Each customer message, agent reply and internal note is its own document, linked to its conversation. The full text lives in those message documents, not in the conversation.

Help Scout permissions are not imported, so every synced conversation and message, including internal notes, is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Conversations deleted in Help Scout stay in HydraDB. Help Scout Docs and attachments are not synced.

notes: Internal notes are synced with every other message. Help Scout's own audience for a note is not imported. Set an access rule on a mailbox whose notes must stay private.

connect.auth: Help Scout uses the App ID and App Secret of a Help Scout app. HydraDB gets a fresh access token from them on every sync, so there is no refresh token to manage.

credentials.name: client_id
credentials.text: The App ID of a Help Scout app owned by the account you connect.

credentials.name: client_secret
credentials.text: The App Secret of that app.

steps.title: Create a Help Scout app
steps.text: In the Help Scout account you want to connect, create an app and copy its App ID and App Secret.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the App ID as `client_id` and the App Secret as `client_secret`.

steps.title: Select mailboxes
steps.text: HydraDB lists the account's mailboxes. Select the ones to sync. Only conversations in selected mailboxes are synced.

connect.account: One connector reads one Help Scout account. An app belongs to one account, so each account needs its own app.

sync.first_sync: Each selected mailbox reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads conversations that changed since the last sync. A conversation counts as changed when a user updated it or the customer started waiting on it. Every message in a changed conversation is read again.
sync.edits: A changed conversation is read again with all its messages, and updates their documents.
sync.deletes: Deleted conversations and messages are not removed. They stay searchable in HydraDB.
notes: A connector created before mailboxes could be selected syncs the whole account.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.helpscout_id
shared_attributes.text: The conversation id on a conversation, the thread id on a message. Targets one item, and keeps later syncs on the same document. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

documents.name: Conversations
documents.title: The conversation subject.
documents.text: The conversation preview, or the subject when the preview is empty. Then `Customer`, `Assignee`, `Mailbox` and `Tags` lines. The status and creation time are part of the text too. The subject is searchable too. The preview is short, so search the messages for the full text.
documents.date: When the conversation was last updated, else when it was created.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The conversation status: active, pending, closed or spam, written as a `Status` line.

attributes.name: customer
attributes.text: The primary customer's name or email, written as the `Customer` line, where HydraDB can identify the person.

attributes.name: assignee
attributes.text: The assigned user's name or email, written as the `Assignee` line, where HydraDB can identify the person.

attributes.name: mailbox
attributes.text: The mailbox name, written as the `Mailbox` line, where HydraDB can identify the mailbox. It does not create a link to a mailbox.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.text: The tag names, written as the `Tags` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the conversation was created, written as a `Created` line. Used as the result date only when there is no update time.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the conversation was last updated. Not searchable.

attributes.name: number
attributes.text: The conversation number Help Scout shows. It is part of the link back.

attributes.name: mailbox_id
attributes.text: The mailbox id. The mailbox name is in `mailbox`.

documents.name: Messages
documents.one_document: One customer message, agent reply or internal note that has a body. Status-only entries are skipped.
documents.title: `Comment by` and the author's name. Without an author, the first 80 characters of the text.
documents.text: An `Author` line, then the message body converted from HTML to text. The creation time is part of the text too.
documents.link_back: None. Open the conversation from its own document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.text: The name or email of whoever wrote the message, else the customer, written as the `Author` line. The graph records the message as written by that person.

attributes.name: mentions
attributes.text: Names @mentioned in an internal note. The names stay in the note text, and the graph records each as mentioned.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The conversation the message belongs to. Links the message to its conversation, so the whole exchange can be returned together.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.helpscout_conversation_id
attributes.text: The id of the conversation the message belongs to. Returns every message in one conversation. Not searchable.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the message was created, written as a `Created` line.

attributes.name: type
attributes.text: `customer`, `message` or `note`, so you can tell a customer message from an internal note.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The message's status in Help Scout.

example_searches: What did the customer say in the latest conversation about a refund?
Which open conversations are assigned to Maria?
Which conversations mention refunds in the billing mailbox?

people: The customer, the assignee and the mailbox appear in the conversation text, where HydraDB can identify them.
graph.from_text: The conversation preview with its customer, assignee, mailbox and tag lines, and the body of every message.

not_synced: Help Scout Docs, the knowledge base, which uses a separate API and key.
Users, teams, workflows, saved replies and mailbox folders, as documents of their own.
Deletions: deleted conversations and messages stay in HydraDB.
